name: Noise Cancelling Headphones of Isolation
flavor_text: Blocks out the haters. Advantage on Concentration checks.

name: Hoodie of Anonymity
flavor_text: A plain black hoodie. You blend into any urban environment.

name: Ergonomic Laptop Stand
flavor_text: Prevents posture damage during long work sessions.

name: Blue Light Glasses
flavor_text: Protects eyes from screen glare. See through digital illusions.

name: Mechanical Keyboard of Clacking
flavor_text: Every keystroke sounds like a tiny lawsuit.
rules_text: Retired duplicate. Use canonical weapon weapon_keyboard.

name: Hydroflask of Hydration
flavor_text: Holds infinite water (or iced coffee). Stay hydrated, stay chill.

name: Power Bank of Infinite Charge
flavor_text: A power bank with sticker residue, emotional damage, and impossible endurance.
rules_text: Retired duplicate. Use canonical magic item magic_power_bank.

name: Vintage Film Camera
flavor_text: Takes photos that look better than reality. Instant aesthetic.

name: Yoga Mat of Grounding
flavor_text: Center yourself. The mat provides unexpected stability.

name: Ironic T-Shirt
flavor_text: A shirt with a vague slogan. Says nothing, implies everything.

name: Hydroflask of VSCO
flavor_text: And I oop. Can be used as an improvised weapon.

name: Fidget Spinner of Focus
flavor_text: Reduces anxiety through repetitive motion.

name: Vape Pen of Mango Fog
flavor_text: Mango vapor blooms into a coughing-fit haze.
rules_text: Once per long rest, create a 15 ft poison cloud in your zone. Creatures that start their turn inside make a CON save DC 13 or take 1d6 poison damage and become Poisoned until the end of their next turn.

name: Avocado of Everlasting Toast
flavor_text: Regenerates every morning. Millennials can't resist it.

name: Beanie of Hipsterdom
flavor_text: Makes you look like you listen to bands no one's heard of.

name: Flannel Shirt of Lumbersexuality
flavor_text: Look rugged without doing manual labor. Peak aesthetic.

name: Doc Martens of Stomping
flavor_text: Heavy boots that command respect with every step.

name: Tote Bag of Holding
flavor_text: A canvas bag with impossible capacity. Very sustainable.

name: Reusable Straw of Virtue
flavor_text: You are saving the turtles. Let everyone know.

name: Mason Jar of Aesthetics
flavor_text: Everything tastes better in a jar. It's science.

name: Ring Light of Vanity
flavor_text: Perfect lighting anywhere. Your best angle, always.

name: Selfie Stick of Unwanted Reach
flavor_text: A telescoping wand for forcing your personal brand into everyone else's weather.
rules_text: Retired duplicate. Use canonical weapon weapon_selfie_stick.

name: Portable Charger of Life
flavor_text: Emergency power for desperate times.

name: Bluetooth Speaker of Annoyance
flavor_text: Plays music loudly in public. Assert dominance.

name: Smart Watch of Anxiety
flavor_text: Notifies you of everything. Knowledge at a cost.

name: Fitbit of Shaming
flavor_text: Vibrates judgmentally if you haven't moved.

name: Peloton of Penance
flavor_text: Stationary bike of suffering. Cleanses the soul.

name: Yoga Pants of Comfort
flavor_text: Counts as unarmored. Maximum flexibility.

name: Weighted Blanket of Security
flavor_text: Like a hug that doesn't judge you.

name: Essential Oils of Placebo
flavor_text: Cures minor ailments through belief. Maybe.

name: Himalayan Salt Lamp of Vibes
flavor_text: Cleanses the energy in any room. Allegedly.

name: Succulent of Neglect
flavor_text: Thrives on being ignored. A kindred spirit.

name: Monstera of Wealth
flavor_text: The plant that indicates you've made it.

name: Chemex of Snobbery
flavor_text: Makes pour-over coffee. You'll explain the process.

name: Aeropress of Travel
flavor_text: Portable coffee anywhere. A nomad essential.

name: Moka Pot of Patience
flavor_text: Takes forever but worth it. Teaches mindfulness.

name: French Press of Grit
flavor_text: Coffee with texture. Builds character.

name: Cold Brew of Jitters
flavor_text: Concentrated caffeine. Handle with care.

name: Oat Milk of Superiority
flavor_text: Dairy free. Environmentally conscious. Slightly smug.

name: Almond Milk of Sustainability
flavor_text: Uses too much water. A guilty pleasure.

name: Standing Desk Converter
flavor_text: Transform any surface into a standing workspace.

name: Ergonomic Mouse of Carpal Prevention
flavor_text: Protects your wrist. Your livelihood depends on it.

name: Pomodoro Timer of Productivity
flavor_text: 25 minutes of focus. 5 minutes of despair.

name: Bullet Journal of Organization
flavor_text: More time decorating it than using it.

name: Noise Machine of White
flavor_text: Drowns out distractions. Or conversations you're avoiding.
rules_text: Gain +1 to CON checks for restful recovery and +1 WIS focus checks in noisy rooms.

name: Kindle of Infinite Books
flavor_text: A library in your pocket. You'll definitely read them all.

name: AirPods of Ignoring
flavor_text: The universal signal for 'don't talk to me'.

name: Moleskine of Pretension
flavor_text: The notebook of serious thinkers. Or people who want to look like them.

name: Passport Holder of Organization
flavor_text: Keeps your documents safe. Shows you travel.

name: Universal Adapter of Compatibility
flavor_text: Works in any country. A true citizen of nowhere.

name: Packing Cubes of Efficiency
flavor_text: Marie Kondo your luggage. Does it spark joy?

name: Overnight Oats of Overpreparedness
flavor_text: Prepared the night before. Grants calm confidence from knowing you have your life together (you don't).

name: Green Juice of Smug Health Advantage
flavor_text: A horrifying blend of kale, spinach, ginger, and moral superiority. Tastes like lawn clippings and self-righteousness.
